points: Yechezkel, a student of Yirmiyahu, prophesies in exile in Bavel, taken with King Yehoyachin, while the Beis HaMikdash still stands.
Prophecy normally happens only in Eretz Yisrael, yet he receives great visions in exile, and some say in jail. "The heavens opened."
"Thirty years" may count from King Yoshiyahu finding the Sefer Torah and starting a spiritual revival.
Pesukim 4–9 describe the Merkava, a moving throne-chariot with four faces: man, lion, ox, and eagle.
